messages:
matt: Quick note - embeddings doc has a bad example. Page shows `input: "single string"` but API expects `inputs: [string]` (batch). Using the example causes a 400.

carmen: link?

matt: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/docs/api/embeddings.md ~line 42. I opened a WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3580

sylvia: We'll need to update SDK snippets (py/go/ruby). I'll prep changes once we pick the canonical example.

kevin: Also spotted response mismatch: docs show `embedding` but runtime returns `embeddings` array for batch. Breaks codegen/tests.

matt: Proposed: switch main example to batch (`inputs: ["a","b"]`), update OpenAPI examples, add a small "Compatibility" note showing single-item wrapping, and update SDK snippets.

jordan: CI will fail if OpenAPI examples and page examples diverge; ping me when PR is ready and I'll re-run codegen.

sylvia: I pushed python + go snippets to the branch and added a docs-test that validates example JSON against the OpenAPI schema.

deploy-bot: deploy preview up: https://deploy-preview-3580--docs.redwood.ai (expires in 7d) :rocket:

kevin: once codegen aligns response field names, remove the temporary duplicate example. we should not ship two canonical examples.

carmen: agreed. Also update marketing snippets that borrow this example.

matt: updated PR with curl/python examples and OpenAPI spec change. leaving TODO for marketing and ruby. thanks all. :thumbsup:
